purpose: Fictional supplier offers for the CoalitionTravel MVP lot (phases P2 to P6): unit-offer compatibility, simulated negotiation and allocation tests.
limitations: Prices and suppliers are fictional; nothing here is availability, a schedule or a commercial offer.
Seller floors are private parameters of the simulated seller (hypothesis H1); they are used only by the P3 negotiation simulator and are never shown to travellers.
Capacities are chosen so that the MVP lot satisfies hypothesis H2 (7 Tokyo seats against 60); they are not real seat inventories.
Any edit of catalog_v1.json requires updating catalog_sha256 here; the loader refuses a mismatch.
